description: PAID $0.02/call (x402) or subscription / bundle pass. Settled Kalshi weather markets for a series (e.g. KXHIGHNY) or city: per market the ticker, close date, exact close_time (ISO 8601 UTC, Z) and close_time_local (ISO with the city's UTC offset; local_tz IANA zone, null if unknown), settlement_time (Kalshi settlement timestamp, ISO UTC; null if Kalshi gives none) and close_to_settlement_seconds / close_to_settlement_minutes (gap from close to settlement, to spot late settlements or revisions), expiration_time, strike/bucket, yes/no result and settlement payout, plus the observed settlement value per day and the official settlement source. Optional date range. Information only, not betting advice. Historical settlements do not predict future results. 18+. BeGambleAware.org

city.description: Alternative to series: city/station keyword (e.g. London, Chicago)

kind.description: With city: which series type (default high)

series.description: Series ticker, e.g. KXHIGHNY, KXHIGHTEGLL, KXRAINNYC
